title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of NbTaTiV refractory high-entropy alloy prepared by powder metallurgy
process_description: prepared by ball milling high purity (>99.5 wt%) Nb, Ta, Ti, and V powders in equiatomic composition in a tungsten carbide vial with argon atmosphere for 12 hours, followed by spark plasma sintering at 1500°C for 30 minutes under 30 MPa pressure.
